description: 47 Antriksh Legacy India is a space-science innovation team led by Parth Kumar Rai from India. We are passionate about aerospace engineering, planetary science, lunar + Martian exploration, satellites, astronomy and human spaceflight. Our goal is to investigate scientific questions, explore NASA's open data and research, and present creative, evidence-based ideas. We value curiosity, critical thinking and innovation, and believe every discovery begins with a question. DREAM • INNOVATE • EXPLORE!
